project_type: Cloudflare Workers + Hono backend, React + Vite + TailwindCSS frontend SPA
build_system: npm + vite for frontend build, wrangler for CF Workers deployment. No Dockerfile.
test_framework: vitest with tests/ directory. Tests use describe/it/expect pattern. No conftest equivalent needed.
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npx tsc --noEmit' for type checking. 2. Run 'npx vitest run' for tests. 3. Run 'npx vite build' for frontend build.
environment_constraints: node_modules already installed. No Docker, no wrangler deploy. Validate via tsc + vitest + vite build.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md says not to modify code directly - but since we are the coding agent, we implement as needed. Code uses 'ponytail:' comment pattern at top of files.
key_patterns: PaymentGateway interface in src/types.ts with createTransaction() and verifyWebhook() methods. Adapters in src/services/payments.ts follow constructor(key, options) pattern. getPaymentGateway() factory function selects by provider string. Webhooks in src/api/webhooks.ts. Orders flow: checkout -> createTransaction -> webhook callback -> fulfillOrder. Fulfilment in src/services/fulfilment.ts marks items fulfilled/failed. Migrations in migrations/ directory numbered. Frontend pages in src/pages/, use lazy loading in App.tsx. Context providers in src/context/.
directory_structure: src/api/ - Hono route handlers, src/services/ - business logic (payments, fulfilment, auth, herosms, rate-limit), src/pages/ - React page components, src/components/ - React shared components, src/context/ - React context providers, tests/ - vitest test files, migrations/ - D1 SQL migration files
